key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:9D70
name: decay_actor_value_and_dispatch
description: Subtracts a field of a second record from a running counter, clamps it to zero when it goes negative, then selects one of four dispatch calls based on two selector values and runs a follow-up check of table flags.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:9DC4
name: dispatch_actor_action_variant_b
description: Selects between two indirect dispatch calls and a fallback call based on two selector values, then runs the same table-flag follow-up check as its neighbours.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:9DE8
name: dispatch_actor_action_fallback
description: When the second selector is zero it issues a dispatch with a fixed code and offset, otherwise a second dispatch, then runs the table-flag follow-up check.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:9E06
name: dispatch_actor_action_default
description: Always issues one indirect dispatch with a fixed code, then runs the table-flag follow-up check that conditionally calls a further routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:9E7A
name: count_foes_and_announce_outcome
description: Loops over the actor table counting entries whose type is two and whose subtype is fifteen or five, then shows the matching outcome text and calls a sound or notify routine with the counts when the group is non-empty and a global value is below fifty.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:9E8A
name: count_foes_by_kind_in_loop
description: Counts actor-table entries of type two with subtype fifteen or five in a loop bounded by a stored actor count, then reports the counts through the same message and notify calls, gated on a global threshold.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:9EA0
name: tally_foe_kinds_and_report
description: Scans actor-table entries for type two with subtype fifteen or five, counting each kind, and reports non-zero counts with message text and a notify call when a global value is below fifty.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:9EB8
name: tally_foe_kinds_with_flags
description: Walks actor entries counting type-two records with subtype fifteen or five, and reports both counts through message text and a notify call once the walk reaches the stored count.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:9EE4
name: report_outcome_with_bravely_text
description: Shows the text 'Bravely done!' and a notify message for the counted foes when the health value is under five and a count is non-zero, otherwise only when a global value is below fifty; repeats a final check on a global flag.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:9EFC
name: show_foe_outcome_messages
description: Displays the text 'foes fled in retreat.' or 'foes were defeated in battle.' with a notify call for each non-zero count, gated on a global threshold, then runs a final global-flag check.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:9FA2
name: find_actor_near_point
description: Checks other live actors from the table, skipping the actor at the given index and index one, and returns sixteen when one lies within ten horizontally and eight vertically of the given point; otherwise returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A010
name: check_nearby_actor_for_record
description: Compares the position of the record's stored actor index and the record fields against every live actor except index one and the record's own index, returning sixteen when one is within ten horizontally and eight vertically.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A016
name: scan_actors_near_record
description: Iterates over actor indices from one upward, skipping the record's own index and index one, and returns sixteen when a live actor's position is within ten horizontally and eight vertically of the record; returns zero when the table ends.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A0BA
name: scan_actors_near_record_skipping
description: Walks the actor table with a skip-aware loop comparing each live entry's position to the record and returns sixteen when one is within ten horizontally and eight vertically; returns zero if none qualify.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A0CE
name: find_closest_actor_index
description: Walks actor indices from one, measures each qualifying actor's offset to the record, stores the index of the closest one in a global word, and returns the smallest offset found.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A0DE
name: find_closest_actor_for_record
description: Iterates actor indices from zero, computes each qualifying actor's offset from the record, keeps the smallest value in the record and records the matching index in a global word, returning the final minimum.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A142
name: measure_actor_offset_distance
description: Takes the absolute horizontal and vertical differences between two actor positions, returns the horizontal difference, or the result of an indirect library call when the two differences are within a factor of two of each other.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A1C0
name: call_pair_when_within_scale
description: Invokes two indirect library routines in sequence only when the second argument is no greater than twice the first; otherwise does nothing.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A1CC
name: invoke_library_routine_pair
description: Calls two indirect library routines in sequence with no arguments and returns, with no condition checks.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A1DE
name: move_actor_if_unblocked
description: Computes candidate coordinates for an actor record through two indirect calls, tests them with the blocking-actor scan, and stores them into the record only when no blocking actor is found; returns true when stored.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A26C
name: store_actor_position_fields
description: Writes two supplied sixteen-bit values into the position fields of the actor entry selected by the record's index, then returns one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A290
name: draw_indexed_sprite_pair
description: Looks up two coordinate bytes for the given index, draws a fixed-size image at the base position through an indirect draw call, and draws it again at the looked-up offset when the index is below nine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A368
name: build_packed_table_by_mode
description: Chooses a colour constant from the current mode value and a stored flag, clamps the magnitude argument, optionally invokes a library call, then fills thirty-two words with three small values packed per word and passes the table to a library copy routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A56E
name: fill_table_and_wait_frames
description: Repeats thirty-two passes, each filling entries one to thirty-one of a table with values masked to twelve bits from an indirect call, copying the table through a library routine and pausing one frame via another library call.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A5CA
name: pop_and_dispatch_queued_event
description: Takes the next code from a thirty-two-entry circular queue when one is pending, otherwise pauses one frame, then dispatches by code value to text output and indirect calls using stored counters and positions.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A5E8
name: dispatch_next_queued_event
description: Advances the read position of a thirty-two-entry circular queue and dispatches the code it held to the same set of text output and indirect calls, with no empty-queue check.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A7F0
name: dispatch_event_code_direct
description: Switches on a code passed in a data register and runs the matching text output and indirect calls for codes two, three, four, five, seven or ten, with no queue handling.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A870
name: enqueue_event_code
description: Stores the given byte at the write position of a thirty-two-entry circular queue and advances the write position, unless the queue is already full.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A89E
name: print_cstring_at_fixed_position
description: Measures a zero-terminated string, sets a fixed text window through an indirect call with constant arguments, positions the cursor at sixteen and forty-two, and writes the string using its measured length.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A8B6
name: invoke_library_setup_sequence
description: Makes one library call with seven constant arguments and a stored handle, another with two constants, then a parameterless routine, using three library vector stubs in that order.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A8F8
name: measure_and_print_cstring
description: Counts the characters of a zero-terminated string and passes the string address and its length to the text output routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A910
name: call_os_library_routine_no_args
description: Calls one operating-system library function at a fixed offset from a stored library base, with no arguments, and returns; the routine has no other behaviour.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A922
name: wrap_text_into_lines
description: Splits a text string into output lines of at most thirty-seven characters at space boundaries, expands percent tokens from a string table selected by a global index, and emits each line through the line-printing routine until a carriage return, the terminator or the count limit.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A942
name: wrap_text_lines_from_pointer
description: Performs the same space-break line wrapping as its sibling routine, working from a pointer supplied through an address register and emitting each completed line through the line-printing routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A97C
name: wrap_text_resume_scan
description: Resumes the line-wrapping scan partway through a string, copying characters into the line buffer, expanding percent tokens and emitting a line whenever the count passes the limit.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A9AE
name: wrap_text_scan_loop
description: Runs the line-wrapping character loop, copying characters, recording the last space and emitting completed lines through the line-printing routine until the scan limit or the terminator is reached.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A9B0
name: wrap_text_emit_and_scan
description: Emits the pending line, resets the count, and then continues the same character scan that breaks text at spaces and expands percent tokens.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:A9F6
name: wrap_text_emit_line_breaks
description: Terminates the current line buffer, prints it, and then keeps scanning the remaining text for further line breaks at spaces up to the count limit.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AA20
name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction and does nothing; it is an empty routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AA28
name: wrap_text_from_string_index
description: Skips the given number of zero-terminated strings from the start of a fixed string table, then wraps the string found there into lines of at most thirty-seven characters and emits each line through the line-printing routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AA32
name: wrap_text_from_second_table
description: Skips the given number of zero-terminated strings from a second fixed string table, then wraps the string found there into lines of at most thirty-seven characters, emitting each line through the line-printing routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AA3C
name: wrap_text_after_skipping_strings
description: Skips the given number of zero-terminated strings from a supplied address, then wraps the next string into lines of at most thirty-seven characters and emits each line through the line-printing routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AA56
name: print_table_entry_with_separators
description: Prints the table string selected by a global index, then a separator string from global data, then the supplied string, then a second separator string.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AAAA
name: print_table_entry_then_text
description: Prints the table string selected by a global index, then a separator string from global data, then the supplied string.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AAE6
name: print_indexed_table_string
description: Prints the table string selected by the current global index through the text output routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AB06
name: init_display_and_palette_state
description: Points the block pointer at a working record, copies a field into it, makes two library calls with the record and constant arguments, stores a fixed mask word, runs a helper, copies thirty-two table words through a library routine, and sets a mode byte to two.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AB70
name: init_alternate_display_state
description: Points the block pointer at a second record, stores a fixed mask word, runs two helper routines, and sets a mode byte to three.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AB92
name: step_levels_down_with_pauses
description: Calls a routine with the current level in three argument positions, a zero and the table, pauses one frame, and lowers the level by five each pass from one hundred down to zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:ABC4
name: step_levels_up_with_pauses
description: Calls a routine with the current level in three argument positions, a zero and the table, pauses one frame, and raises the level by five each pass from zero up to one hundred.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:ABFA
name: clear_record_fields_and_run
description: Zeroes two fields of the record referenced by a stored pointer and then runs a routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AC1A
name: run_scripted_helper_sequence
description: Copies a stored long word to another location, makes ten helper calls with small constant arguments and values read from stored fields, copies a status word, and finishes with two parameterless helper calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AC9C
name: append_segment_record_if_fits
description: Reads three byte fields and a size word from an eight-byte table entry into a running record, and when the running offset plus the entry size stays within a fixed upper bound, calls a helper with the entry values and advances the offset.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AE0C
name: fill_slot_record_from_template
description: Selects a fifty-six-byte slot by index, releases it through an indirect call if it is already marked as type two, copies a fifty-six-byte template into it, sets its type to two, stores two shifted positions and a third value, and passes the slot to a routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AE8E
name: load_template_record_and_call
description: Copies a fifty-six-byte template into a fixed buffer, clears a long field, sets a word field to nine, and passes the buffer to an indirect call.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AEBA
name: forward_call_to_helper
description: Calls a helper routine with no arguments and returns, doing nothing else.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AEC6
name: dispatch_slot_record_draw
description: Passes a fixed buffer to an indirect call, clears a word, then forwards the stored long words and three words from the eighteen-byte entry selected by its argument to a routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AF40
name: forward_slot_unless_status_clear
description: Returns without action only when the slot is marked as type two and an indirect status check returns zero; otherwise it forwards the slot to a helper routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:AF66
name: load_song_chunks_from_file
description: Opens a data file by its numeric id, reads up to twenty-eight length-prefixed chunks into a buffer while recording each chunk's offset in a table, stops before the total would exceed a fixed size limit, and closes the file; the referenced text is songs.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:B012
name: setup_view_then_draw_pair
description: When a global flag is clear, waits through a library call for three hundred fifty units, sets up a 320 by 200 view through an indirect call, passes two supplied values to a second indirect call, and runs a helper followed, when it returns zero, by two more helpers.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:B0A0
name: draw_bar_rows_from_tables
description: Iterates twenty-two rows, reads two byte tables per row, draws a background rectangle through an indirect call, then draws a series of segment rectangles whose heights come from a helper call and the table values, and pauses a frame after each row whose delay byte is non-zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:B364
name: test_input_code_thirty_two
description: Reads a code through an indirect input call, sets a flag to one when the code equals thirty-two, and returns the same test result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:B386
name: copy_block_above_address_bound
description: When the supplied address value is above a fixed bound, allocates a block of the requested size through an indirect call, copies that many bytes into it and returns the new block; otherwise returns the original pointer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:B3CC
name: draw_quad_with_orientation_flags
description: Computes two signed cross products from four corner points built from the record and grid offsets, stores a sign flag for each, then when a temporary buffer can be allocated, draws the corner shape into it through indirect calls, restores the saved values and releases the buffer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:B70E
name: set_state_and_forward_record
description: Sets a state word to two, forwards a fixed-size record and a stored value to a routine, forwards a table-selected pointer and a second value, and copies the state word into a counter word when it exceeds three.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:B770
name: store_actor_marker_record
description: Copies the x coordinate of an actor entry and its y coordinate plus ten into a record, sets the record's first byte to the supplied value and its second byte to one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:B7B2
name: update_table_entry_marker
description: Locates a record either directly by index or through a per-slot offset table, then sets its marker byte to twenty-nine when that byte held fifteen, otherwise stores the supplied byte in the following field.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:B7FA
name: update_slot_marker_by_offset
description: Finds the record through a per-slot offset table, then sets its marker byte to twenty-nine when that byte held fifteen, otherwise stores the supplied byte in the following field.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:B828
name: store_byte_to_offset
description: Writes the byte held in the data register to the location five bytes past the address register, with no other operations.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:B834
name: register_nearby_entries_from_list
description: When a group's active flag is clear and a counter exceeds nine, fills ten table slots with entries at random positions retried until a test passes, then walks the supplied list and registers each record inside a screen window into the actor table with a kind code, recording special kinds in global flags.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:B884
name: register_nearby_entries_from_stack
description: Performs the same spawn-and-register procedure as its sibling, reading the list pointer and count from the stack frame rather than from arguments.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:B98E
name: register_nearby_entries_loop
description: Walks the supplied list and registers each record inside the screen window into the actor table with a kind code, using the same kind test and special-kind flags as its siblings, and stops at the supplied count or when the table is full.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BA8E
name: scan_entries_for_registration
description: Advances to the next record, stops when the remaining count reaches zero or the table is full, and applies the screen-window test and registration steps to each record it reaches.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BA92
name: skip_out_of_window_entries
description: Advances through the record list past records outside the screen window, then registers the first record found inside the window through the same kind-code and table-insertion steps.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BB3E
name: finish_registered_record_fields
description: Fills the kind-four fields of a newly registered table record with the entry's offset and a kind code of fifteen or thirteen depending on the source kind, copies the position words into it, and advances through the list under the window test.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BBAE
name: register_or_refresh_record
description: Refreshes the position words of a matching existing record or fills a new record with its kind-specific fields and offset, then advances through the list applying the screen-window test to each entry.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BBE8
name: append_window_entry_records
description: Appends a new record for each in-window list entry, filling its kind byte, position offset and a value from the stack frame, and refreshes the matching record instead when one already exists.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BC5A
name: append_window_entry_flagged
description: Appends in-window list entries as records whose kind byte is zero for source kind five and one otherwise, copies their position words, and advances the list until the count is exhausted.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BC70
name: append_window_entry_default_kind
description: Appends in-window list entries as records with a default kind byte of one, switching to zero for source kind five and two for source kind six, copies their position words, and advances the list.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BCB2
name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction and does nothing; it is an empty routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BCE6
name: prompt_and_verify_typed_entries
description: Shows a prompt for up to three pending text entries picked through an indirect call, reads typed printable characters with backspace handling up to nine characters until carriage return, and compares them with the stored string, returning zero on a mismatch and one after three matches.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BD88
name: verify_typed_entries_loop
description: Continues the same prompt, read and compare cycle after a match, clearing the matched entry, advancing the match count and returning zero on a mismatch or one once three matches are reached.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BD98
name: verify_typed_entries_resume_input
description: Enters the typed-entry read loop partway through, echoing a printable character to the buffer when one is received, and continues reading until carriage return, returning zero on a mismatch or one after three matches.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BDC8
name: compare_then_prompt_next_entry
description: Compares the typed buffer with the stored string and returns zero on a mismatch, clears the matched entry and returns one after three matches, otherwise selects and displays the next pending entry and reads typed characters again.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BDEA
name: compare_typed_buffer_and_advance
description: Compares the typed buffer with the stored string through a pointer register, returning zero on a mismatch, otherwise clearing the entry, counting the match and prompting for the next pending entry before reading input again.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BDEC
name: count_typed_matches_until_three
description: Clears a matched entry, increments the match count and returns one once three matches are recorded, otherwise selects the next pending entry, reads typed input and compares it with the stored string, returning zero on a mismatch.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BE0C
name: call_six_library_routines
description: Makes six library calls with no arguments in sequence, three through the executive library base and three through a stored library base, and returns the register pair unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BE70
name: store_result_and_release_if_set
description: Calls a routine with two arguments, stores the returned value, passes that value to a release routine when it is non-zero, and returns the stored value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BE9E
name: open_df0_and_check_type
description: Opens the device named by the referenced text df0 with a mode argument of minus two and stores the handle; when the handle is non-zero it checks a type field against two hundred thirty, calls a helper if it differs, passes the handle to a release routine and returns the handle.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BEFA
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The bytes decode as bad instruction data, so this is only a stub that halts decoding and performs no behaviour.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BEFE
name: wait_for_flag_with_timeout
description: Polls a flag byte, pausing five units through a library call between checks for at most three hundred polls; clears the flag and returns one when it is set, or returns zero when the poll limit passes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BF08
name: poll_flag_until_limit
description: Repeatedly pauses five units through a library call and checks a flag byte, counting polls in the stack frame; clears the flag and returns one when it is set, or returns zero once the count reaches three hundred.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BF18
name: poll_flag_with_counter_loop
description: Pauses five units through a library call and checks a flag byte in a loop that stops after three hundred polls; clears the flag and returns one when it is set, otherwise returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BF32
name: exchange_state_blocks_with_file
description: Opens a file on the device named by the referenced text df1 with a numeric id chosen by a flag, and when it opens passes a sequence of state blocks with their sizes to a transfer routine before closing it; a failed open is recorded and the routine loops over the status checks and prompts.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BF62
name: exchange_state_blocks_from_df0
description: Waits for input on the disk prompt, opens a file on the device referenced as df0 with a numeric id chosen by a flag, and passes the same sequence of state blocks with their sizes to a transfer routine before closing it; the status is reported through a display call, and the referenced text includes winpic.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BF8E
name: exchange_state_blocks_after_prompt
description: Shows the referenced prompt asking for a writable disk in any drive and waits for input, then runs the same open, block transfer and close sequence, reporting the aborted text when the user cancels.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BFAE
name: exchange_state_blocks_with_retry
description: Loops waiting for input on the disk prompt, then performs the file open, block transfer and close sequence with the drive letter derived from a stored index, reporting status and restoring the display state afterwards.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BFB0
name: exchange_state_blocks_direct
description: Opens the file for the drive letter derived from a stored index, transfers the same sequence of state blocks with their sizes, closes it, and restores the display state without any prompt.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:BFDA
name: exchange_state_blocks_fixed_file
description: Opens the file with a fixed numeric id, transfers the state blocks with their sizes, closes it and reports the status, then restores the display state.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C0BA
name: report_save_error_and_restore
description: Shows the referenced message that the game could not be saved when the status is non-zero, waits for input, and restores the display state without opening any file.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C0DA
name: report_load_error_and_restore
description: Shows the referenced message that the game could not be loaded, loops waiting for input, then restores the display state and flags.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C108
name: wait_for_game_disk_and_restore
description: Shows the referenced request to insert the game disk and loops until input arrives, then restores the display state and flags.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C118
name: reset_display_state_and_restore
description: When the mode flag is clear, resets two state words, runs helper routines, sets a counter to ninety-nine, runs further helpers with small constant arguments, clears two flags, and restores the display through a library call.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C228
name: transfer_block_and_check_status
description: Transfers a block through a file-handle call, or through a direct transfer call when the mode flag is set, and calls the error routine when the returned status is negative.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C24C
name: transfer_block_from_frame
description: Transfers a block whose handle, address and size come from the stack frame through the file-handle call, and calls the error routine when the returned status is negative.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C276
name: store_rect_around_point
description: Writes a four-field rectangle into the table slot chosen by the first argument, spanning two hundred fifty units left and right and two hundred units above and below the given point.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C2D0
name: advance_counter_and_setup_view
description: Refreshes display entries selected by a counter that this routine increments, pauses through a library call, sets a view rectangle with fixed coordinates through a library call, and adds three to a run of table bytes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C3F8
name: animate_palette_wave_sweep
description: Passes the referenced text winpic to an indirect call, then runs a descending sweep of about fifty steps that builds a thirty-two-word table from a source table offset by the step and two indirect values, copies it through a library routine and pauses between steps.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C4B8
name: animate_palette_wave_loop
description: Continues the palette sweep from inside its step loop, refilling thirty-two table entries from the source table at the current offset, copying them through a library routine and pausing between steps until the sweep ends.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C4E4
name: animate_palette_wave_steps
description: Runs the palette sweep steps with two indirect values per step, refilling the table from the source table, copying it through a library routine and pausing, and ends when the step passes the lower bound.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C574
name: select_value_by_table_flag
description: Returns ten when the flag byte at the given index in the table is non-zero, otherwise returns eight.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C586
name: place_marker_at_stored_position
description: When the low two bits of a stored counter are zero or a state byte exceeds ninety-seven, calls an indirect routine with coordinates offset from the stored position by a flag-dependent amount, or with fixed coordinates when the index is eight or above, and returns its result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C59A
name: place_marker_without_flag_offset
description: Under the same counter and state condition, calls an indirect routine with coordinates offset from the stored position without any flag-dependent shift, or with fixed coordinates when the index is eight or above, and returns its result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C5EE
name: call_fixed_position_marker
description: Calls an indirect routine unconditionally with fixed coordinates of one hundred, a unit flag and the table, and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C610
name: dispatch_actor_mode_action
description: Stores a mode code in the actor record and runs the matching action for codes one through ten, such as a step toward coordinates taken from the record or the stored target, a timer adjustment or a fixed-coordinate step, gated where needed by a random check, then returns the action result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C630
name: dispatch_actor_mode_register
description: Stores the mode code held in a data register in the actor record and runs the same mode-matched action set for codes one through ten, returning the action result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C662
name: dispatch_actor_mode_partial
description: Holds the distance-check and mode-two, mode-four, mode-eight and mode-ten branches of the actor mode dispatcher with unreachable blocks removed, and updates only the record's state byte in those branches.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C694
name: dispatch_actor_mode_with_flag
description: Runs the mode-matched action set using a flag argument in place of the random gate for modes three, five, two, six and ten, and sets the record's state byte to twelve for modes four and ten.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C740
name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns, with no other behaviour.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C760
name: dispatch_actor_mode_gated
description: Runs the mode-matched actions for modes two through six and ten, gated by a flag register, and sets the record's state byte to twelve for modes four and ten.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C784
name: dispatch_actor_mode_no_distance
description: Runs the gated actions for modes three, five, two, six and ten with no distance check and no mode-four branch, setting the record's state byte to twelve for mode ten.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C7B2
name: dispatch_actor_mode_minimal
description: Runs the gated actions for modes five, two, six and ten only, setting the record's state byte to twelve for mode ten.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C7E0
name: dispatch_actor_mode_two_six_ten
description: Runs the gated actions for modes two, six and ten, with a mode-two check that sets the record's state byte to four when the actor matches a stored index, and sets the state byte to twelve for mode ten.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C83A
name: dispatch_actor_mode_six_ten
description: Runs the gated action for mode six and the gated action for mode ten, setting the record's state byte to twelve for mode ten.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C852
name: lookup_actor_when_flagged
description: When the flag register is non-zero, looks up a table entry through an indirect call with argument two, derives an offset from the result, and passes it to a routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C896
name: set_state_byte_for_mode_ten
description: When the mode register equals ten, calls a routine if the flag register is non-zero and then stores the constant twelve into the record's state byte; otherwise does nothing.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C8C4
name: decrement_counter_clamp_and_notify
description: Subtracts the supplied amount from a stored counter and, when the result goes negative, clamps the counter to zero and calls a routine with the code thirteen; otherwise it calls a routine with the global text argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C8E6
name: print_yum_text
description: Passes the global text argument, which is the referenced text Yum, to a single output routine and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:C920
name: scan_index_and_read_block
description: Opens the file with a numeric id and scans its index for an entry matching a stored key; when one matches it reads the data block and passes each cell offset, stepped by the record's stride, to a routine in a grid of rows and columns, returning one on success and zero otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:CBBA
name: advance_record_timer_and_dispatch
description: Clears a flag byte in the record, adds a word-sized step from the record to a long field at offset sixteen, and when the first byte is zero calls a routine four times with no arguments, returning the register pair unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:CBE6
name: step_audio_channel_sequence
description: Advances one audio channel's sequence stream: when its timer is due it reads command byte pairs for instrument select, volume, and loop or end, looks up a value in a table and writes the channel's sample fields, and otherwise fetches the next data byte into the channel's note value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:CF02
name: decrement_counter_and_update_state
description: Writes two constant words into the first structure, then decrements a byte counter in the second structure when it is non-zero; when the counter reaches zero it writes two words to other offsets of the first structure, and it always writes a constant word to the first structure.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:CF38
name: start_audio_channel_one
description: Sets two state bytes, then programs audio channel one by writing a volume of sixty-four, the sample address from the first argument, the length and period from the other two arguments, clears its pending interrupt request, enables its interrupt and switches on its DMA channel.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:CF8C
name: silence_audio_channel_one
description: Clears bit zero of a state byte, sets the channel one volume register to zero and its period register to two, which silences audio channel one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:CFB8
name: store_per_channel_long_values
description: Stores four long-word arguments into four per-channel state slots spaced evenly through the state block, one slot for each audio channel.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:CFDE
name: reset_all_audio_channels
description: Stores the four long-word arguments into per-channel slots, zeroes the four channel volume registers and the channel state fields, copies four words from a table into per-channel fields, marks each channel's state byte, and enables DMA for all four audio channels.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D09A
name: stop_all_audio_channels
description: Zeroes the four channel volume registers, disables DMA for the four audio channels by writing their enable bits without the set flag, and marks a state byte with the all-ones value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D0C0
name: install_music_vblank_interrupt
description: Stores three arguments and fills two interrupt-server structures referenced as audio four and music vblank, registers them through the exec library's add-server and set-vector calls, and clears and disables one audio interrupt through the interrupt registers.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D16A
name: remove_music_vblank_interrupt
description: Calls a routine, removes the registered interrupt server through the exec library, writes a single-bit value to an interrupt-related field of the structure, and restores the interrupt vector through the library.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D19A
name: clear_buffer_and_set_fields
description: Computes an offset from a stored index, writes a constant field, zeroes nine hundred forty-seven long words of a buffer at a fixed offset, stores two values into fields, and calls a routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D1E4
name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction and does nothing; it is an empty routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D1EA
name: open_dos_and_parse_arguments
description: Opens the library referenced as dos.library, then either writes the tag MANX into a startup block and loads a file by numeric id, or splits the supplied argument text into quoted or space-separated tokens, stores a pointer for each token in a table, and passes that table to a routine; it reports an error routine when the library cannot be opened.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D4DC
name: copy_string_pad_zeros
description: Copies bytes from the source string into the destination until the given count is used up or a terminator is copied, then fills the remaining count with zero bytes, and returns the destination.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D4FE
name: append_string_bounded
description: Moves to the end of the destination string, then copies the source string onto it, stopping at the terminator or at a fixed limit near thirty-two thousand characters, and returns the destination.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D504
name: append_string_with_limit
description: Moves to the end of the destination string, copies the source string onto it until the terminator or until the counter runs out, writes a terminator when the copy was cut short, and returns the destination.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D528
name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies the source string into the destination byte by byte, including its terminator, and returns the original destination pointer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D538
name: cross_multiply_16bit_halves
description: Splits each of two thirty-two-bit register values into sixteen-bit halves, sums the cross products of those halves, and returns that sum in the high long alongside the second operand in the low long.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D55C
name: apply_sign_to_helper_result
description: Takes two signed register values, works out whether their signs differ, calls a helper, negates the helper's result when the signs differed, and returns that result together with the second operand.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D584
name: negate_helper_result_if_negative
description: Calls a helper, then negates the value it leaves in the second data register when the first operand is negative, and returns that value together with the original second operand.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D59E
name: call_and_return_concatenated
description: Calls a routine and returns a pair of longs made from the original second data register and the value that the call leaves in that register.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D5AA
name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls one unnamed routine with no arguments and returns, with no other behaviour.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D5B4
name: perform_32bit_division
description: Divides a thirty-two-bit dividend by a divisor: for divisors above sixteen bits it runs a shift-and-subtract loop of sixteen steps, otherwise it uses two sixteen-bit divide steps, and returns the quotient and remainder as a pair of longs.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D604
name: compute_string_length
description: Walks a zero-terminated string to its terminator and returns the number of bytes before it, without modifying memory.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D616
name: call_optional_hook_then_routine
description: Calls a stored routine pointer when it is non-zero, then calls another routine with no arguments and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D634
name: release_stored_resources
description: Calls one routine twenty times, calls a stored hook when it is set, releases up to three stored resources and two stored buffers through routines when they are held, and returns the result of a final call when no extra resource is held.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D6E8
name: release_slot_entry
description: Checks that the slot index lies within twenty entries and that the entry is set, returning minus one and recording error code three otherwise; when valid it releases the stored handle through a routine unless the top bit of the entry's flag word is set, clears the entry and returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D738
name: call_library_vector_through_handle
description: Calls a library function through a vector at a fixed offset from a library base stored in a handle field, with no arguments, and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D774
name: call_library_routine_via_handle
description: Calls a different library function through a vector at another fixed offset from a library base stored in a handle field, with no arguments, and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D78C
name: call_library_routine_from_handle
description: Calls a library function at a fixed offset from the library base stored in a handle field, with no arguments, and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a5]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a5].adf:FMAIN:0:D79E
